About The Product +
  • No mess, no noise, just glide: With an advanced vacuum system, ceramic blades, and ultra quiet motor that makes grooming easy, clean and effortless.
  • Vaccum tech that sucks (Hair): So that all the trimmed hair goes directly into the bin while you use it, instead of making a mess all over the sink.
  • Made for body & balls: As it adapts to every curve and contour of your body, giving you total control even in the trickiest areas.
  • Ceramic blades that stay cool: With 70% less heat generated than metal blades, making them safer and more convenient on sensitive areas.
  • Ultra quiet motor: So that you trim in peace with a powerful but silent motor that gets the work done without making a big deal about it.
  • Waterproof & shower safe: With its IPX7 waterproof rating that can handle all types of contact with water – wash it, drop it or use it in the shower.


Country of Origin: India

Imported & Marketed by: Visage Lines Personal Care Private Limited, 5th Floor, Vipul Plaza, Golf Course Road, Sector 54, Suncity, Gurugram, Haryana – 122011

How To Use +
  • Charge fully before first use using a Type-C cable.
  • Attach your desired comb length or use directly for a close trim.
  • Power on and move gently in the direction of hair growth.
  • The vacuum system will collect the trimmed hair automatically.
  • After use, detach the blade and rinse under water.
  • Clean and dry before storing back.
  • Do not leave the trimmer running when not in use.
